answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in glacier, verified in meadow, and horizon names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 12 submissions per epoch. A 274 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
